newsitem.title: USA: Claire's Stores sees record-setting Q4.
newsitem.headline: Claire's Stores sees record-setting Q4.

text.p: Claire's Stores Inc said Tuesday it expects its fourth quarter to set records, bolstered by a holiday selling season that it expects to be its "best ever."

"Our inventories are perfectly positioned for the holiday season, in terms both of dollars and the right merchandise," Claire's Stores Chairman and Chief Executive Rowland Schaefer said in a statement.
"This year's expansion means we have 250 more stores than we had at this time last year and we plan to open 35 more by Thanksgiving," he added.
In the prior year's fourth quarter, the company reported net income of $19.7 million, or $0.94 per share, on sales of $119.66 million.
